checks.detail: stop must sit on the invalidation side of entry for the trade direction
a zero-risk (entry==stop) plan is degenerate
target must be in the trade direction from entry
surfaced R:R must equal |target−entry|/|entry−stop| — this number gates 'take'
every ladder target must sit in the trade direction from entry
every ladder target must sit in the trade direction from entry
ladder targets must be ordered outward from entry (T2 beyond T1)
each ladder leg's R:R must equal its own recompute
each ladder leg's R:R must equal its own recompute
conviction must be a finite value within its declared domain
size_factor must be a finite value within its declared domain
rank score must be a non-negative finite number
math.score must be a finite value within its declared domain
math.population.score must be a finite value within its declared domain
math.symbol_aware.score must be a finite value within its declared domain
math.symbol_empirical.win_rate must be a finite value within its declared domain
entries[now].trigger must mirror its source entry_now leg
entries[now].stop must mirror its source entry_now leg
entries[now].target must mirror its source entry_now leg
entries[now].rr must mirror its source entry_now leg

HTF lean must come from Confluence-v2, never the legacy scorer
HTF timeframe must be exactly one step above the entry TF
the lean fused into the decision must equal the lean in its provenance block
htf_agree must equal (lean agrees with direction) AND (not capped by an HTF wall)
alignment must follow confluence lean vs trade direction
an agreeing setup should read as with-trend context
